integrity: The proof is analytic: the nonsymmetric case follows from the exact first derivative at the original basis, while the symmetric case reduces to a one-variable rational function with explicitly signed derivative. Numerical checks are supplemental only. The plank-theorem literature is assigned primary MSC 52-02 by the cited open-access survey.
scientific limitations: The result classifies sharpness of the two-dimensional orthonormal-basis variational certificate in the 2026 proof. It does not claim that the certificate radius is the globally optimal core-theorem avoidance radius, gives no closed formula for the nonsymmetric case, and does not classify dimensions above two.
title: Exact planar sharpness locus of the new Ball-plank basis certificate
